name: one-pr-built-directly
description: A one-repo, one-PR change becomes one issue built directly, with no sub-issues.
prompt: /plan-work plan Fix the typo 'Totla' on the invoice footer in the `web` repo, file src/invoice/Footer.tsx. It shows to every customer today. No tracker tool in this session: show the draft and stop. Do not run any tool except reading files and the bundled lint.

assertions.description: an issue built directly carries its repo
